purpose: Fairly test whether correctly aligned real logs add value beyond numerical metrics on the two GAIA DB instances.

input_policy.numeric_source: prefix-only cache only; original CSV must not be opened

training.loss: mean squared metric reconstruction + 1.0 * fixed information-bottleneck loss
training.early_stopping_metric: fixed-RNG reconstruction MSE on [4515,5644), lower is better
training.checkpoint_selection: strictly lower early-stop reconstruction MSE; first checkpoint wins exact ties
training.checkpoint_policy: last at step 1, every 50 optimizer updates and every epoch; best at improvement; evaluation_start immediately before deterministic scoring
training.initialization_rule: fresh PyTorch module initialization after fixing Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA seed; Qwen from the same frozen local pretrained snapshot; each service is initialized in a fresh process
training.data_order_rule: one complete torch.randperm of all 4492 train windows per epoch using a private CPU Generator seeded seed+epoch; no drop_last; final batch size 4

qwen.pooling: final hidden state projected to four prompt tokens

bert_log_cache.pooling: all non-special tokens, chunked mean during frozen cache construction

B2.name: MetricOnlyNullLog
B2.log_source: all-zero feature tensor, present=0, learnable missing token
B2.capacity_match: same log encoder, fusion and reconstruction head as B3/B4

B3.name: MetricLogShifted
B3.log_source: fixed +240-minute circular source mapping independently within each split

B5.name: FullDualReference
B5.training: historical checkpoint; never retrain in this baseline runner
B5.interpretation: contextual reference only; it is not a same-run single-component causal ablation

evaluation.threshold_selection: maximum ordinary point F1 on proposal validation; first frozen candidate wins ties

decision_rules.real_log_increment: B4 AP must exceed both B2 and B3 on each service, and B4 VUS-PR must not be lower than either control on either service
decision_rules.stat_prompt_increment: B1 AP must exceed B0 AP; report both services and macro average
decision_rules.dual_reference_increment: B5 AP greater than B4 is descriptive only; because B5 is historical, it cannot alone prove a causal dual-objective effect

seed_extension_gate.condition: Only after complete seed-2021 B0-B4 results: B4 must beat both B2 and B3 in AP on both services and must not reduce VUS-PR on either service; both services must succeed and test_used must remain false

known_shared_limitations: full-window statistical prompt can access masked-region statistics
offline/non-causal scoring can use future context
the preserved statistical prompt contains the historical financial-domain description
deterministic soft gate differs from historical hard Gumbel scoring
